correctness.rationale: Formal completeness iff no isolated vertices in the undecided induced subgraph is proved from the Dung quantifiers for each vertex. On a bidirected cycle this is exactly the exclusion of isolated length-one undecided runs, equivalently forbidden clockwise gap 4. Distinguished-vertex counting derives n/k coefficients with correct n=2 correction. Rational simplification, recurrence and pole residue are checked symbolically. Independently written checker verifies the defender definition against gap and composition enumerations on every one of 131064 subsets for orders 3..16. Nonstandard enumeration step and limiting constant are justified analytically, not inferred from experiments.

originality.rationale: Compared the theorem as a statement with the strongest inspected antecedents: symmetric admissibility (Coste-Marquis et al. 2005), legal labelling enumeration and bidirectional cycle benchmarks (Rodrigues 2017), pseudo-complete closure enumeration (Obiedkov–Sertkaya 2026), earlier related stable-cycle disagreement and bidirected-path triple-diversity invariants, plus published-finding corpus searches for cycle gap/complete extensions/size profiles and broader identities. None identified an all-orders cycle complete-extension polynomial or implied the non-stable gap law; uncertainty remains about unindexed 3-state lattice-gas formulations.
residual_risks: A previously published transfer-matrix or three-state statistical-mechanics formula for legal Dung labellings on undirected cycles could be algebraically identical despite different terminology.
A preexisting indexed complete-extension sequence or unlabeled cycle composition table was not exhaustively ruled out by targeted search.
General extension algorithms can calculate every fixed n but, without a symbolic reduction, their publication is not proof of the displayed all-order identity.

value.rationale: Complete classification and size-refined count of all complete extensions for a canonical infinite strongly-connected symmetric argumentation family, including a structural forbidden gap and exact exponential separation between complete versus preferred/stable extension totals. This gives a natural benchmark for complete-extension enumeration, not an arbitrary slice or tiny numerical gain; proof supplies an all-order rational formula and growth constant.
